sentences.text: Après l'accident, Paul a appris à chérir chaque journée passée avec ses enfants.
sentences.en: After the accident, Paul learned to cherish every day spent with his children.
sentences.ko: 사고 뒤 폴은 아이들과 보내는 하루하루를 소중히 여기게 됐어요.

sentences.text: Émilie apprend à chérir les longues soirées d'été au jardin.
sentences.en: Émilie learns to cherish the long summer evenings in the garden.
sentences.ko: 에밀리는 정원에서 보내는 긴 여름 저녁을 소중히 여기게 돼요.

sentences.text: Paul et son voisin de chambre sont devenus inséparables pendant leur séjour à l'hôpital.
sentences.en: Paul and his roommate became inseparable during their hospital stay.
sentences.ko: 폴과 같은 병실 환자는 입원하는 동안 단짝이 됐어요.

sentences.text: Au printemps, Émilie et sa sœur sont inséparables dans les champs de fleurs.
sentences.en: In spring, Émilie and her sister are inseparable in the flower fields.
sentences.ko: 봄이면 에밀리와 동생은 꽃밭에서 떨어질 줄 몰라요.

sentences.text: Malgré ses soixante ans, Paul garde un enthousiasme juvénile qui fait sourire les infirmières.
sentences.en: Despite his sixty years, Paul keeps a youthful enthusiasm that makes the nurses smile.
sentences.ko: 예순인데도 폴은 젊은이 같은 열정을 간직해서 간호사들이 미소 지어요.

sentences.text: Le printemps rend à Émilie une énergie presque juvénile.
sentences.en: Spring gives Émilie back an almost youthful energy.
sentences.ko: 봄이 오면 에밀리는 젊은이 같은 기운을 되찾아요.

sentences.text: L'infirmière prend la température de Paul sous l'aisselle.
sentences.en: The nurse takes Paul's temperature under his armpit.
sentences.ko: 간호사가 폴의 겨드랑이로 체온을 재요.

sentences.text: En plein été, Émilie a des auréoles de sueur sous l'aisselle.
sentences.en: In midsummer, Émilie has sweat stains under her armpit.
sentences.ko: 한여름이면 에밀리는 겨드랑이에 땀 자국이 생겨요.

sentences.text: La veille de l'opération, Paul est trop angoissé pour dormir.
sentences.en: The night before the operation, Paul is too anxious to sleep.
sentences.ko: 수술 전날 밤 폴은 너무 불안해서 잠을 못 자요.

sentences.text: Les jours courts de novembre rendent Émilie un peu angoissée.
sentences.en: The short days of November make Émilie a little anxious.
sentences.ko: 십일월의 짧은 낮은 에밀리를 조금 불안하게 해요.

sentences.text: Le pharmacien met Paul en garde contre les médicaments de contrefaçon vendus en ligne.
sentences.en: The pharmacist warns Paul against counterfeit medicines sold online.
sentences.ko: 약사가 폴에게 인터넷에서 파는 가짜 약을 조심하라고 해요.

sentences.text: Au marché d'été, Émilie évite les lunettes de soleil de contrefaçon.
sentences.en: At the summer market, Émilie avoids counterfeit sunglasses.
sentences.ko: 여름 장터에서 에밀리는 가짜 선글라스를 피해요.

sentences.text: Le médecin demande à Paul de retracer la chronologie de ses symptômes.
sentences.en: The doctor asks Paul to retrace the timeline of his symptoms.
sentences.ko: 의사가 폴에게 증상이 나타난 순서를 되짚어 보라고 해요.

sentences.text: Émilie note dans un carnet la chronologie des premières fleurs de son jardin.
sentences.en: Émilie notes in a notebook the timeline of the first flowers in her garden.
sentences.ko: 에밀리는 정원에서 꽃이 처음 피는 순서를 수첩에 적어요.

sentences.text: Paul n'a qu'une petite éraflure au bras, mais on le garde en observation.
sentences.en: Paul only has a small scratch on his arm, but they keep him under observation.
sentences.ko: 폴은 팔에 작은 생채기뿐이지만 병원은 경과를 지켜보려고 그를 붙잡아 둬요.

sentences.text: En taillant les rosiers en automne, Émilie se fait une éraflure à la main.
sentences.en: Pruning the roses in autumn, Émilie gets a scratch on her hand.
sentences.ko: 가을에 장미를 가지치기하다가 에밀리는 손에 생채기가 나요.

sentences.text: Dans la chambre voisine, la femme de Paul se remet d'une césarienne.
sentences.en: In the next room, Paul's wife is recovering from a caesarean.
sentences.ko: 옆 병실에서 폴의 아내가 제왕절개 수술에서 회복하고 있어요.

sentences.text: La fille d'Émilie est née par césarienne un jour de neige.
sentences.en: Émilie's daughter was born by caesarean on a snowy day.
sentences.ko: 에밀리의 딸은 눈 오는 날 제왕절개로 태어났어요.

sentences.text: L'ambulance de Paul a été bloquée à une intersection pendant de longues minutes.
sentences.en: Paul's ambulance was stuck at an intersection for long minutes.
sentences.ko: 폴을 태운 구급차가 교차로에서 한참 동안 멈춰 있었어요.

sentences.text: En hiver, Émilie ralentit toujours à l'intersection, où la route gèle vite.
sentences.en: In winter, Émilie always slows down at the intersection, where the road freezes quickly.
sentences.ko: 겨울이면 에밀리는 길이 금방 어는 교차로에서 늘 속도를 줄여요.

sentences.text: Paul garde ses papiers d'hôpital dans une pochette en plastique.
sentences.en: Paul keeps his hospital papers in a plastic sleeve.
sentences.ko: 폴은 병원 서류를 비닐 파일에 넣어 둬요.

sentences.text: Émilie range les graines du printemps dans une pochette en papier.
sentences.en: Émilie stores the spring seeds in a paper envelope.
sentences.ko: 에밀리는 봄에 뿌릴 씨앗을 종이 봉투에 넣어 둬요.

sentences.text: Après l'hémorragie, Paul a reçu une transfusion de sang.
sentences.en: After the hemorrhage, Paul received a blood transfusion.
sentences.ko: 출혈 뒤에 폴은 수혈을 받았어요.

sentences.text: L'hiver dernier, le père d'Émilie a eu besoin d'une transfusion après une chute sur la glace.
sentences.en: Last winter, Émilie's father needed a transfusion after a fall on the ice.
sentences.ko: 지난겨울 에밀리의 아버지는 빙판에서 넘어진 뒤 수혈이 필요했어요.

sentences.text: De sa fenêtre, Paul voit une parcelle de jardin cultivée par les soignants.
sentences.en: From his window, Paul sees a garden plot tended by the hospital staff.
sentences.ko: 창문으로 폴은 의료진이 가꾸는 텃밭 한 뙈기를 봐요.

sentences.text: Au printemps, Émilie bêche sa parcelle au jardin partagé.
sentences.en: In spring, Émilie digs her plot in the community garden.
sentences.ko: 봄이면 에밀리는 공동 텃밭의 자기 땅을 갈아요.

sentences.text: Paul rêve de reprendre sa vieille décapotable dès sa sortie de l'hôpital.
sentences.en: Paul dreams of getting back in his old convertible as soon as he leaves hospital.
sentences.ko: 폴은 퇴원하자마자 낡은 오픈카를 다시 몰 꿈을 꿔요.

sentences.text: Dès les premiers beaux jours, Émilie sort sa décapotable du garage.
sentences.en: As soon as the first fine days arrive, Émilie takes her convertible out of the garage.
sentences.ko: 날이 풀리자마자 에밀리는 차고에서 오픈카를 꺼내요.

sentences.text: Un spasme dans le dos réveille Paul au milieu de la nuit.
sentences.en: A spasm in his back wakes Paul in the middle of the night.
sentences.ko: 한밤중에 등 경련 때문에 폴이 잠에서 깨요.

sentences.text: Le froid de janvier provoque chez Émilie un spasme dans la nuque.
sentences.en: The January cold gives Émilie a spasm in the neck.
sentences.ko: 일월 추위에 에밀리는 목덜미에 경련이 와요.

sentences.text: L'indifférence d'un médecin pressé blesse Paul plus que la douleur.
sentences.en: The indifference of a rushed doctor hurts Paul more than the pain.
sentences.ko: 바쁜 의사의 무관심이 통증보다 더 폴의 마음을 아프게 해요.

sentences.text: Émilie ne regarde jamais l'arrivée de l'automne avec indifférence.
sentences.en: Émilie never greets the arrival of autumn with indifference.
sentences.ko: 에밀리는 가을이 오는 걸 한 번도 무심히 넘긴 적이 없어요.

sentences.text: Le jardinier de l'hôpital explique à Paul que la vallée a toujours eu une terre très fertile.
sentences.en: The hospital gardener explains to Paul that the valley has always had very fertile soil.
sentences.ko: 병원 정원사가 폴에게 이 골짜기 땅은 예로부터 아주 기름졌다고 설명해요.

sentences.text: Après les pluies d'automne, la terre du jardin d'Émilie redevient fertile.
sentences.en: After the autumn rains, the soil in Émilie's garden becomes fertile again.
sentences.ko: 가을비가 내린 뒤 에밀리의 정원 흙이 다시 기름져져요.

sentences.text: Les collègues de Paul lui apportent un bouquet de tulipes jaunes.
sentences.en: Paul's colleagues bring him a bouquet of yellow tulips.
sentences.ko: 폴의 동료들이 노란 튤립 꽃다발을 가져와요.

sentences.text: En avril, Émilie plante une rangée de tulipes le long de l'allée.
sentences.en: In April, Émilie plants a row of tulips along the path.
sentences.ko: 사월에 에밀리는 오솔길을 따라 튤립을 한 줄 심어요.

sentences.text: Paul est arrivé aux urgences complètement déshydraté après une journée en plein soleil.
sentences.en: Paul arrived at the emergency room completely dehydrated after a day in full sun.
sentences.ko: 폴은 땡볕에서 하루를 보낸 뒤 완전히 탈수된 채 응급실에 왔어요.

sentences.text: Après une randonnée d'août, Émilie rentre déshydratée et boit deux litres d'eau.
sentences.en: After an August hike, Émilie comes home dehydrated and drinks two liters of water.
sentences.ko: 팔월 산행에서 돌아온 에밀리는 탈수가 와서 물을 두 리터나 마셔요.

sentences.text: Dans le bassin du parc de l'hôpital, Paul regarde nager une grosse carpe.
sentences.en: In the pond in the hospital grounds, Paul watches a big carp swim.
sentences.ko: 병원 정원 연못에서 폴은 커다란 잉어가 헤엄치는 걸 봐요.

sentences.text: Quand l'étang gèle, Émilie se demande où se cache la vieille carpe.
sentences.en: When the pond freezes, Émilie wonders where the old carp hides.
sentences.ko: 연못이 얼면 에밀리는 늙은 잉어가 어디 숨는지 궁금해요.

sentences.text: Un pétale de rose est tombé sur le plateau-repas de Paul.
sentences.en: A rose petal has fallen onto Paul's meal tray.
sentences.ko: 폴의 식판 위에 장미 꽃잎 하나가 떨어졌어요.

sentences.text: Au printemps, le vent dépose un pétale de cerisier dans le café d'Émilie.
sentences.en: In spring, the wind drops a cherry blossom petal into Émilie's coffee.
sentences.ko: 봄바람에 벚꽃 꽃잎 하나가 에밀리의 커피잔에 떨어져요.

sentences.text: Paul s'est blessé au genou en jouant au rugby avec ses amis.
sentences.en: Paul hurt his knee playing rugby with his friends.
sentences.ko: 폴은 친구들과 럭비를 하다가 무릎을 다쳤어요.

sentences.text: L'automne, c'est la saison du rugby, et Émilie suit tous les matchs.
sentences.en: Autumn is rugby season, and Émilie follows every match.
sentences.ko: 가을은 럭비 시즌이라 에밀리는 모든 경기를 챙겨 봐요.

sentences.text: Devant l'hôpital, un grand érable devient rouge pendant le séjour de Paul.
sentences.en: In front of the hospital, a big maple turns red during Paul's stay.
sentences.ko: 폴이 입원해 있는 동안 병원 앞 큰 단풍나무가 빨갛게 물들어요.

sentences.text: En octobre, Émilie ramasse les feuilles rouges de l'érable du jardin.
sentences.en: In October, Émilie gathers the red leaves of the garden maple.
sentences.ko: 시월이면 에밀리는 정원 단풍나무의 붉은 잎을 주워요.

sentences.text: Le pédiatre explique à Paul que son fils entre dans la puberté.
sentences.en: The pediatrician explains to Paul that his son is entering puberty.
sentences.ko: 소아과 의사가 폴에게 아들이 사춘기에 접어들었다고 설명해요.

sentences.text: Le fils d'Émilie a beaucoup grandi cet été, signe que la puberté arrive.
sentences.en: Émilie's son grew a lot this summer, a sign that puberty is coming.
sentences.ko: 에밀리의 아들이 올여름 부쩍 커서 사춘기가 오는 것 같아요.

sentences.text: À sa sortie, Paul serre sa fille dans une longue étreinte.
sentences.en: When he leaves, Paul holds his daughter in a long embrace.
sentences.ko: 퇴원하면서 폴은 딸을 오래 꼭 껴안아요.

sentences.text: Au retour du printemps, Émilie accueille sa grand-mère d'une étreinte chaleureuse.
sentences.en: When spring returns, Émilie welcomes her grandmother with a warm embrace.
sentences.ko: 봄이 돌아오면 에밀리는 할머니를 따뜻하게 꼭 안아 맞아요.

sentences.text: Le kiné de Paul est toujours ponctuel, à neuf heures pile.
sentences.en: Paul's physiotherapist is always punctual, at nine sharp.
sentences.ko: 폴의 물리치료사는 늘 아홉 시 정각에 맞춰 와요.

sentences.text: Chaque année, le retour des hirondelles est ponctuel, remarque Émilie.
sentences.en: Every year, the swallows' return is punctual, Émilie notes.
sentences.ko: 해마다 제비가 어김없이 제때 돌아온다고 에밀리가 말해요.

sentences.text: La kiné demande à Paul de marcher à une cadence régulière.
sentences.en: The physiotherapist asks Paul to walk at a steady pace.
sentences.ko: 물리치료사가 폴에게 일정한 속도로 걸으라고 해요.

sentences.text: En été, Émilie travaille à une cadence plus lente à cause de la chaleur.
sentences.en: In summer, Émilie works at a slower pace because of the heat.
sentences.ko: 여름이면 에밀리는 더위 때문에 일을 더 느린 속도로 해요.

sentences.text: Le dermatologue prescrit à Paul une crème au soufre pour sa peau.
sentences.en: The dermatologist prescribes Paul a sulfur cream for his skin.
sentences.ko: 피부과 의사가 폴에게 피부에 바를 유황 크림을 처방해요.

sentences.text: Près de la source chaude, l'air de l'hiver sent le soufre, remarque Émilie.
sentences.en: Near the hot spring, the winter air smells of sulfur, Émilie notes.
sentences.ko: 온천 근처의 겨울 공기에서 유황 냄새가 난다고 에밀리가 말해요.

sentences.text: Le vieux voisin de Paul n'est pas sénile, il est seulement un peu sourd.
sentences.en: Paul's old neighbor isn't senile, he's just a bit deaf.
sentences.ko: 폴의 나이 든 이웃은 노망난 게 아니라 귀가 좀 어두울 뿐이에요.

sentences.text: Le vieux chien d'Émilie devient un peu sénile et dort tout l'hiver près du poêle.
sentences.en: Émilie's old dog is getting a little senile and sleeps all winter near the stove.
sentences.ko: 에밀리의 늙은 개는 조금 노망이 나서 겨우내 난로 옆에서 자요.

sentences.text: Paul est à l'hôpital à cause d'une piqûre de guêpe qui a mal tourné.
sentences.en: Paul is in hospital because of a wasp sting that went wrong.
sentences.ko: 폴은 말벌에 쏘인 게 덧나서 병원에 있어요.

sentences.text: En septembre, une guêpe tourne autour de la tarte aux prunes d'Émilie.
sentences.en: In September, a wasp circles around Émilie's plum tart.
sentences.ko: 구월에 말벌 한 마리가 에밀리의 자두 타르트 주위를 맴돌아요.

sentences.text: Paul regarde à la télévision un documentaire sur les grands fauves d'Afrique.
sentences.en: Paul watches a documentary on TV about Africa's big cats.
sentences.ko: 폴은 텔레비전으로 아프리카 맹수 다큐멘터리를 봐요.

sentences.text: Les feuilles d'automne prennent des teintes fauves dans la forêt d'Émilie.
sentences.en: The autumn leaves take on tawny hues in Émilie's forest.
sentences.ko: 에밀리네 숲의 가을 잎이 황갈색으로 물들어요.

sentences.text: Le voisin de chambre de Paul lui raconte que l'infidélité a brisé son mariage.
sentences.en: Paul's roommate tells him that infidelity broke up his marriage.
sentences.ko: 같은 병실 환자가 폴에게 외도 때문에 결혼이 깨졌다고 털어놓아요.

sentences.text: Émilie lit un roman d'hiver où une infidélité déchire une famille.
sentences.en: Émilie reads a winter novel in which an infidelity tears a family apart.
sentences.ko: 에밀리는 외도로 가족이 갈라지는 겨울 소설을 읽어요.

sentences.text: Le médecin parle à Paul d'un épuisement lié au travail.
sentences.en: The doctor talks to Paul about work-related exhaustion.
sentences.ko: 의사가 폴에게 일로 인한 탈진 이야기를 해요.

sentences.text: À la fin de l'hiver, Émilie ressent un vrai épuisement et rêve de soleil.
sentences.en: At the end of winter, Émilie feels real exhaustion and dreams of sunshine.
sentences.ko: 겨울이 끝날 무렵 에밀리는 완전히 지쳐서 햇볕을 그리워해요.

sentences.text: Paul s'est cassé la clavicule en tombant de son vélo.
sentences.en: Paul broke his collarbone falling off his bike.
sentences.ko: 폴은 자전거에서 떨어져 쇄골이 부러졌어요.

sentences.text: Émilie s'est fêlé la clavicule en glissant sur une plaque de verglas.
sentences.en: Émilie cracked her collarbone slipping on a patch of black ice.
sentences.ko: 에밀리는 빙판에 미끄러져 쇄골에 금이 갔어요.

sentences.text: Sur un panneau, Paul lit que la mortalité infantile a beaucoup baissé en un siècle.
sentences.en: On a board, Paul reads that infant mortality has fallen a lot in a century.
sentences.ko: 폴은 게시판에서 한 세기 동안 영아 사망률이 크게 줄었다는 걸 읽어요.

sentences.text: Émilie lit que les vagues de chaleur augmentent la mortalité chez les personnes âgées.
sentences.en: Émilie reads that heat waves increase mortality among the elderly.
sentences.ko: 에밀리는 폭염이 노인 사망률을 높인다는 글을 읽어요.

sentences.text: Depuis son virus, Paul a perdu une partie de son odorat.
sentences.en: Since his virus, Paul has lost part of his sense of smell.
sentences.ko: 바이러스를 앓은 뒤 폴은 후각을 일부 잃었어요.

sentences.text: Au printemps, l'odorat d'Émilie se réveille avec le parfum des lilas.
sentences.en: In spring, Émilie's sense of smell wakes up with the scent of lilacs.
sentences.ko: 봄이 오면 라일락 향기에 에밀리의 후각이 깨어나요.

sentences.text: Paul craint de rester invalide après son accident de chantier.
sentences.en: Paul fears being left disabled after his building-site accident.
sentences.ko: 폴은 공사 현장 사고 뒤에 장애가 남을까 봐 걱정해요.

sentences.text: Le voisin d'Émilie, devenu invalide, regarde passer les saisons depuis sa fenêtre.
sentences.en: Émilie's neighbor, now disabled, watches the seasons go by from his window.
sentences.ko: 몸이 불편해진 에밀리의 이웃은 창가에서 계절이 지나가는 걸 지켜봐요.

sentences.text: Paul s'est déchiré un tendon de la cheville en descendant l'escalier.
sentences.en: Paul tore a tendon in his ankle going down the stairs.
sentences.ko: 폴은 계단을 내려가다가 발목 힘줄이 찢어졌어요.

sentences.text: Émilie s'étire bien avant de courir pour protéger son tendon d'Achille du froid.
sentences.en: Émilie stretches well before running to protect her Achilles tendon from the cold.
sentences.ko: 에밀리는 추위에 아킬레스건을 보호하려고 달리기 전에 스트레칭을 충분히 해요.

sentences.text: Le chirurgien montre à Paul un schéma de l'aorte avant l'intervention.
sentences.en: The surgeon shows Paul a diagram of the aorta before the procedure.
sentences.ko: 외과 의사가 수술 전에 폴에게 대동맥 그림을 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: Le cardiologue explique à Émilie que la chaleur de l'été fatigue aussi l'aorte.
sentences.en: The cardiologist explains to Émilie that summer heat also strains the aorta.
sentences.ko: 심장내과 의사가 에밀리에게 여름 더위가 대동맥에도 부담을 준다고 설명해요.

sentences.text: Le médecin demande à Paul s'il y a une maladie héréditaire dans sa famille.
sentences.en: The doctor asks Paul if there is a hereditary disease in his family.
sentences.ko: 의사가 폴에게 집안에 유전병이 있는지 물어요.

sentences.text: L'allergie au pollen d'Émilie est héréditaire : sa mère éternue aussi chaque printemps.
sentences.en: Émilie's pollen allergy is hereditary: her mother also sneezes every spring.
sentences.ko: 에밀리의 꽃가루 알레르기는 유전이에요. 어머니도 봄마다 재채기를 하거든요.
